title: Nocturne theme page: surface cards name themselves from their visible text

source.ref: Extra pass on /themes pages 2026-11-03: axe WCAG 2.1 AA at 1280 and 390 on nocturne, network, designer, temple

detail:
The four surface cards joined by dotted lines on /themes/nocturne carried aria-label 'Preview the website' and so on, which left the visible words (the sub-line) out of the accessible name (WCAG 2.5.3, four nodes). The label is gone; the name now comes from the card's own text. Axe is clean on all four theme pages at 1280 and 390 after this.

 Fixed 2026-11-03.
